411: The riches you gain through your ears, by listening to good teaching, are the treasure of all treasures. Of all riches, they come first.
415: The words of people who live the right way are like a walking stick for someone walking on slippery ground.
419: People who have not gained fine, deep learning by listening find it hard to speak humbly.
433: People who are afraid of being blamed treat even a fault as small as a millet seed as if it were as big as a palmyra palm (a very tall tree).
447: Who can ruin people who keep friends that scold them when they are wrong?
458: Even people of good character who already have a very good mind find that good friends make them safer and stronger.
467: Think it through first, and then decide what to do. Saying “we will think about it after we start” is a mistake.
473: Many people did not know how strong they really were. They rushed into a task, driven only by eagerness, and broke down halfway.
491: Do not start any action against an enemy, and do not look down on them, until you have found a place from which you can surround and defeat them.
521: Even when someone has lost everything, it is only relatives who still honor the old bond they shared.
522: If a person has relatives whose love never fails, they will bring that person many kinds of good fortune that keep on growing.
523: A person who does not share their heart with their relatives is like a big pond with no banks: whatever water comes in just flows away.
525: A person who gives freely and speaks kindly will be surrounded by relatives, circle after circle of them.
526: No one on this wide earth has more relatives around them than a person who gives generously and does not hold on to anger.
